en.text: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

zhSimplified.text: 主知道法利赛人听见他收门徒，施洗，比约翰还多，（

zhTraditional.text: 主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，（

en.text: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

zhSimplified.text: 其实不是耶稣亲自施洗，乃是他的门徒施洗，）

zhTraditional.text: 其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）

en.text: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

zhSimplified.text: 他就离了犹太，又往加利利去。

zhTraditional.text: 他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。

en.text: He needed to pass through Samaria.

zhSimplified.text: 必须经过撒马利亚，

zhTraditional.text: 必須經過撒馬利亞，

en.text: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

zhSimplified.text: 于是到了撒马利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。

zhTraditional.text: 於是到了撒馬利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。

en.text: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里有雅各井；耶稣因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那时约有午正。

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。

en.text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Giveme a drink.”

zhSimplified.text: 有一个撒马利亚的妇人来打水。耶稣对她说：「请你给我水喝。」（

zhTraditional.text: 有一個撒馬利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對她說：「請你給我水喝。」（

en.text: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

zhSimplified.text: 那时门徒进城买食物去了。）

zhTraditional.text: 那時門徒進城買食物去了。）

en.text: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

zhSimplified.text: 撒马利亚的妇人对他说：「你既是犹太人，怎么向我一个撒马利亚妇人要水喝呢？」原来犹太人和撒马利亚人没有来往。

zhTraditional.text: 撒馬利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒馬利亞人沒有來往。

en.text: Jesus answered her, “Ifyou knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「你若知道 神的恩赐，和对你说『给我水喝』的是谁，你必早求他，他也必早给了你活水。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「你若知道上帝的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」

en.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「先生，没有打水的器具，井又深，你从哪里得活水呢？

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裏得活水呢？

en.text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

zhSimplified.text: 我们的祖宗雅各将这井留给我们，他自己和儿子并牲畜也都喝这井里的水，难道你比他还大吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裏的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」

en.text: Jesus answered her, “Everyonewho drinks of this water will thirst again,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「凡喝这水的还要再渴；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「凡喝這水的還要再渴；

en.text: butwhoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

zhSimplified.text: 人若喝我所赐的水就永远不渴。我所赐的水要在他里头成为泉源，直涌到永生。」

zhTraditional.text: 人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裏頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」

en.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「先生，请把这水赐给我，叫我不渴，也不用来这么远打水。」

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」

en.text: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你去叫你丈夫也到这里来。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裏來。」

en.text: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “Yousaid well, ‘I have no husband,’

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「我没有丈夫。」耶稣说：「你说没有丈夫是不错的。

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。

en.text: foryou have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

zhSimplified.text: 你已经有五个丈夫，你现在有的并不是你的丈夫。你这话是真的。」

zhTraditional.text: 你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」

en.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「先生，我看出你是先知。

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「先生，我看出你是先知。

en.text: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们的祖宗在这山上礼拜，你们倒说，应当礼拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」

en.text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「妇人，你当信我。时候将到，你们拜父，也不在这山上，也不在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。

en.text: Youworship that which you don’ t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

zhSimplified.text: 你们所拜的，你们不知道；我们所拜的，我们知道，因为救恩是从犹太人出来的。

zhTraditional.text: 你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。

en.text: Butthe hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

zhSimplified.text: 时候将到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心灵和诚实拜他，因为父要这样的人拜他。」

zhTraditional.text: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。」

en.text: Godis spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

zhSimplified.text: 神是个灵，所以拜他的必须用心灵和诚实拜他。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」

en.text: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

zhSimplified.text: 妇人说：「我知道弥赛亚（就是那称为基督的）要来；他来了，必将一切的事都告诉我们。」

zhTraditional.text: 婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」

en.text: Jesus said to her, “Iam he, the one who speaks to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「这和你说话的就是他！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」

en.text: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

zhSimplified.text: 当下门徒回来，就希奇耶稣和一个妇人说话；只是没有人说：「你是要什么？」或说：「你为什么和她说话？」

zhTraditional.text: 當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和她說話？」

en.text: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

zhSimplified.text: 那妇人就留下水罐子，往城里去，对众人说：

zhTraditional.text: 那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裏去，對眾人說：

en.text: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

zhSimplified.text: 「你们来看！有一个人将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了，莫非这就是基督吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」

en.text: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

zhSimplified.text: 众人就出城，往耶稣那里去。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人就出城，往耶穌那裏去。

en.text: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

zhSimplified.text: 这其间，门徒对耶稣说：「拉比，请吃。」

zhTraditional.text: 這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」

en.text: But he said to them, “Ihave food to eat that you don’ t know about.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我有食物吃，是你们不知道的。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」

en.text: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒就彼此对问说：「莫非有人拿什么给他吃吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」

en.text: Jesus said to them, “Myfood is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我的食物就是遵行差我来者的旨意，做成他的工。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。

en.text: Don’tyou say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

zhSimplified.text: 你们岂不说『到收割的时候还有四个月』吗？我告诉你们，举目向田观看，庄稼已经熟了，可以收割了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了，可以收割了。

en.text: Hewho reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

zhSimplified.text: 收割的人得工价，积蓄五谷到永生，叫撒种的和收割的一同快乐。

zhTraditional.text: 收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。

en.text: Forin this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

zhSimplified.text: 俗语说：『那人撒种，这人收割』，这话可见是真的。

zhTraditional.text: 俗語說：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。

en.text: Isent you to reap that for which you haven’ t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

zhSimplified.text: 我差你们去收你们所没有劳苦的；别人劳苦，你们享受他们所劳苦的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」

en.text: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

zhSimplified.text: 那城里有好些撒马利亚人信了耶稣，因为那妇人作见证说：「他将我素来所行的一切事都给我说出来了。」

zhTraditional.text: 那城裏有好些撒馬利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」

en.text: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

zhSimplified.text: 于是撒马利亚人来见耶稣，求他在他们那里住下，他便在那里住了两天。

zhTraditional.text: 於是撒馬利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裏住下，他便在那裏住了兩天。

en.text: Many more believed because of his word.

zhSimplified.text: 因耶稣的话，信的人就更多了，

zhTraditional.text: 因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，

en.text: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

zhSimplified.text: 便对妇人说：「现在我们信，不是因为你的话，是我们亲自听见了，知道这真是救世主。」

zhTraditional.text: 便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」

en.text: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

zhSimplified.text: 过了那两天，耶稣离了那地方，往加利利去。

zhTraditional.text: 過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。

en.text: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶稣自己作过见证说：「先知在本地是没有人尊敬的。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」

en.text: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

zhSimplified.text: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看见他在耶路撒冷过节所行的一切事，就接待他，因为他们也是上去过节。

zhTraditional.text: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。

en.text: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他从前变水为酒的地方。有一个大臣，他的儿子在迦百农患病。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。

en.text: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

zhSimplified.text: 他听见耶稣从犹太到了加利利，就来见他，求他下去医治他的儿子，因为他儿子快要死了。

zhTraditional.text: 他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。

en.text: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unlessyou people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就对他说：「若不看见神迹奇事，你们总是不信。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」

en.text: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

zhSimplified.text: 那大臣说：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子还没有死就下去。」

zhTraditional.text: 那大臣說：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」

en.text: Jesus said to him, “Goyour way. Your son lives.”The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他说：「回去吧，你的儿子活了！」那人信耶稣所说的话就回去了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。

en.text: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

zhSimplified.text: 正下去的时候，他的仆人迎见他，说他的儿子活了。

zhTraditional.text: 正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。

en.text: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

zhSimplified.text: 他就问什么时候见好的。他们说：「昨日未时热就退了。」

zhTraditional.text: 他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」

en.text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Yourson lives.”He believed, as did his whole house.

zhSimplified.text: 他便知道这正是耶稣对他说「你儿子活了」的时候；他自己和全家就都信了。

zhTraditional.text: 他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。

en.text: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

zhSimplified.text: 这是耶稣在加利利行的第二件神迹，是他从犹太回去以后行的。

zhTraditional.text: 這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
